notes: 8 configurations on 7 equipment entries from 5 manufacturers (MVE Biological Solutions: XC 34/18 and SC 4/2V; Martin Christ: Epsilon 2-10D LSCplus; SPEX SamplePrep: 6875 Freezer/Mill; Minitube: IceCube 14M and 14S; PHC: MDF-MU339HL-PE and MDF-DC500VX). NIST WebBook is used only as reference data for the liquid-phase LN2 temperature of the XC 34/18. All sources accessed 2026-11-01. None duplicates data/cryostats or the other v4 industry files (XC 34/18 differs from healthcare's XC 47/11; SC 4/2V Next Generation differs from healthcare's CryoShipper XC / SC 4/3V; Epsilon 2-10D differs from the 2-4/2-6D in biology/chemistry; MDF-DC500VX and MDF-MU339HL-PE differ from biology's MDF-DU702VH). Every configuration documents all 11 core-passport keys except three on the SPEX mill (see not_found); absences (magnet, sample vacuum, base pressure, viewport, sample wiring) are install=not_available quoting the complete specification table or feature list that defines the machine's scope. Conventions: single storage temperature -> lo = hi (XC 34/18 at 77.34 K, NIST; SPEX vial in LN2 at -195.8 C from the SPEX handbook); freezers use the guaranteed CONTROL range, not the wider setting range; top-loading spaces (chest freezer, IceCube, dewar canisters): diameter = smaller horizontal dimension / canister diameter, height = vertical depth / canister height; front-loading cabinet (MU339HL): diameter = smaller of width and depth, height = interior height; freeze-dryer shelf: diameter = smaller shelf dimension, height = standard shelf spacing. MVE XC 34/18 holding_time.static stores the printed 'Normal Working Duration' (123 days, liquid storage, normal use) because this sheet prints no separate static hold; it is a lower bound of the true static hold. electrical.sample_connections=true on the Christ dryer (standard product-temperature/LyoControl sensors) and the IceCube (Pt-100 product probe) means sensor wiring to the product only, not general power feedthroughs. SPEX magnetic_field.max is deliberately NOT an absence: the mill applies an alternating drive field of unpublished strength. Categories not delivered because no reachable full specification was found in this run (WebSearch budget and Tavily quota were exhausted, so only known/linked manufacturer URLs could be read): cryogenic tunnel/IQF freezers (Linde CRYOLINE MT/SC/TI pages give no temperature or size data), Planer Kryo 370 (spec sheet hosted only on mail/support.planer.com whose TLS certificate is invalid), IMV Digitcool alpha (flyer lacks temperature range and cooling rates), walk-in seed-bank cold rooms, and dedicated -60 C marine tuna freezers.
